motion_notes: Slide-in 0.3s ease-out; count-up 6 steps; stagger 0.18s; ticker drift; winner-pop.
selection_rule: Open on hook_card; numbers duel or lead; one player posters; moments goal/fixture/score; voice quote/discipline/welcome.

layouts.purpose: Head-to-head duel: navy vs orange zones, photo flanks, winner numeral lime.
layouts.sourcing: Winner computed from supplied numbers; ties render both white.

layouts.purpose: Vertical leader list: micro label + giant numeral rows on kit red.
layouts.sourcing: One number per row; cutout must be approved media.

layouts.purpose: Side-split poster: torn photo left, brush surname, meta + stats.
layouts.sourcing: Portrait must be an approved library image of the named player.

layouts.purpose: Top-photo poster: torn photo band, meta columns, stat columns.
layouts.sourcing: Portrait must be an approved library image of the named player.

layouts.purpose: Goal moment: giant backdrop word + chant + score pill.
Next match: header, V + shield slots, date + stadium.
layouts.sourcing: No real crests; drawn shield outlines only.

layouts.purpose: Up-next list: up to 3 fixture rows on white panel.
Final score: full-bleed photo + giant scoreline + shield bug.
layouts.sourcing: Score from reviewed evidence with source+date.

layouts.purpose: Pull quote: duotone photo + paper box + seal.
layouts.sourcing: Quote must exist in reviewed evidence.

layouts.purpose: Player of the match: dark photo + giant POTM + name pill.
layouts.sourcing: Portrait must be an approved library image of the named player.

layouts.purpose: Card incident: edge letters + card motifs + name/minute.
Welcome: X-cross field + photo + name pill.
layouts.sourcing: Portrait must be an approved library image of the named player.

layouts.purpose: Frame 0: one 5-8 word claim, punched in.
layouts.sourcing: Claim must exist in reviewed opening narration.

layouts.purpose: Provenance note: publication, date, claim, URL.

previews: Renderer-exported examples in previews/ are illustrative, no real match data.
